subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young Chinese woman in <Picture 1>, a three-view character sheet presenting her front, three-quarter and back view. She has a slender build, a fair complexion, softly defined brows, a small mouth and a calm composed gaze. In <Picture 1> her long black hair is dressed in a high coiled bun secured with a slender gold floral hairpin, with two long loose strands falling past her shoulders. She wears a pale pink hanfu: a translucent wide-sleeved outer robe with fine floral embroidery along the shoulders and cuffs, over a white inner layer with a pink knotted sash at the chest and waist. Her face, skin tone and clothing stay identical to <Picture 1> for the whole shot; only her hair changes, exactly four times, one change per card impact.
<Subject 2> is the gaming desk room in <Picture 2>, a modern studio workspace at night: a black sit-stand desk, two wide monitors on articulating arms, a black ergonomic mesh chair, a red-and-white mechanical keyboard, headphones, a compact speaker, a black desktop PC tower, a continuous blue LED strip washing the wall behind the monitors, and a wall-mounted pegboard with figurines on the right.
<Subject 3> is the portrait card in <Picture 3>: one single portrait card on a pale grey backing, a portrait photograph inside a thick white rounded border with a thin grey outline, roughly the proportions of a paperback book and about as thick, standing upright and reading as a rigid physical object rather than a printed page. The woman printed on it is shown from the front with a clearly readable head of hair: its length, its curl pattern, its fringe, and above all its colour are plain and unmistakable.
<Subject 4> is the portrait card in <Picture 4>: same white rounded border and rigid build, a different woman shown from the front with a different head of hair whose length, curl pattern, fringe and colour are all clearly readable.
<Subject 5> is the portrait card in <Picture 5>: same white rounded border and rigid build, a third woman shown from the front with a third head of hair whose length, curl pattern, fringe and colour are all clearly readable.
<Subject 6> is the portrait card in <Picture 6>: same white rounded border and rigid build, a fourth woman shown from the front with a fourth head of hair whose length, curl pattern, fringe and colour are all clearly readable.

detailed_description:
The target video is a selfie clip filmed on a phone in a blue-lit gaming room at night, clean high-key light on her face from the monitors and the LED strip, cool blue ambient wash on the background, neutral grade with warm skin tones. The phone lens is the camera, so the framing is a tight handheld medium close-up with a slight wide-angle bulge at the frame edges and a continuous low-amplitude handheld sway. There is one continuous shot with no cuts.
[Shot 1] The frame opens on <Subject 1> inside <Subject 2>, her face filling the centre of the frame at a slight high angle because the phone is held above her eye line, her shoulders and upper chest visible, the blue LED wall and the two monitors falling softly out of focus behind her. Her right arm is extended toward the lens holding the phone, so her right forearm enters the bottom right of the frame. She smiles at herself in the screen and tilts her head a few degrees with her long black hair still in its high coiled bun. The right half of the frame is empty.
At 00:01.100 a single card matching <Subject 3> slides in from outside the right edge of the frame, travelling leftward at a steady glide, and comes to rest hovering in the air beside her left cheek at roughly her eye height, bobbing once as it settles. It is the only card in the frame, held face-on so the hair printed on it is fully visible.
At 00:01.800 that card snaps toward her, tumbles end over end across the last stretch, and slaps flat against her forehead just below the hairline. On contact a thin ring of white light bursts outward across her face, her eyes squeeze shut for one frame, and when they open her entire head of hair is the hair printed on <Subject 3> - the same length, the same curl pattern, the same fringe, and the same hair colour as the woman on that card, the new strands swinging once and settling around her face. The spent card drops out of the bottom of the frame and the air beside her is empty again.
At 00:02.900 a single card matching <Subject 4> slides in from the right edge on the same path and hovers in the same place, and at 00:03.600 it strikes her left temple; the white ring flashes and her hair is replaced by the exact hair printed on <Subject 4> - its length, its curl pattern, its fringe and its hair colour all copied from that card, the new colour reading clearly against her skin. The card falls away and the air clears.
At 00:04.700 a single card matching <Subject 5> slides in from the right and hovers, and at 00:05.400 it hits her right cheekbone; the ring flares and her hair becomes exactly the hair printed on <Subject 5> - its length, its curl pattern, its fringe and its hair colour, springing out and bouncing twice before it holds. The card drops away.
At 00:06.500 a single card matching <Subject 6> slides in from the right and hovers, and at 00:07.200 it lands across her brow; the white ring expands past the frame edges and her hair settles into exactly the hair printed on <Subject 6> - its length, its curl pattern, its fringe and its hair colour, the ends swinging once across her shoulder. The spent card drops out of frame and no card remains in the air.
From 00:07.300 to the end she lowers her free hand out of frame, drops her chin slightly, looks straight into the phone lens with a small satisfied closed-mouth smile, and turns her head a few degrees to one side so the hair from the last card swings across her shoulder; the camera keeps its handheld sway and holds on her face through the final frame.
Throughout the shot exactly one card is ever visible at a time: a card never appears while another card is still in the air, each card enters from the right edge, and each impact is card-to-face contact on the front of her head with a small flinch and blink. Her hair colour after an impact always matches the card that just hit her and never drifts back toward her original black, so the four states read as four distinctly different hair colours one after another. Nothing else in the room moves except the drifting blue light on the back wall. Her clothing, the desk, the monitors and the pegboard never change.

overall_soundscape:
A close, intimate phone-microphone room tone with a faint ventilation hum, a soft airy whoosh as each card glides in from the right, a crisp paper snap and a dull thump as it slaps her skin, a brief high shimmer on every white ring burst, and the quiet rustle of her own hair re-forming after each hit.

non_diegetic_music:
A playful mid-tempo electronic pop bed with a light plucked synth loop and a soft kick, a short bright pitched blip landing exactly on each card impact, the blips stepping up in pitch across the four hits, and a warm sustained chord that opens over the last second as she settles.

There is no speech and no singing anywhere in this video, and no text, logo, caption or watermark appears on screen or on any of the cards.

detailed_description:
The video is a realistic, cinematic drama shot in a warm-lit bedroom, focusing on emotional expression and physical continuity.

[Shot 1]
<Subject 1> stands facing <Subject 2> inside <Subject 3>. The lighting is warm, coming from the hanging lamp. <Subject 1> raises his right hand sharply and delivers a slap to <Subject 2>'s face. The camera tracks the motion of the hand. The impact causes <Subject 2>'s head to snap to the side.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000
<Subject 2> stumbles backward and falls onto the wooden bed, landing on the plaid sheets. She curls up slightly, clutching her face, with visible tears and a pained expression. <Subject 1> remains standing, looking down at her. The camera tilts down slightly to follow her fall.

[Shot 3] At 00:07.000
<Subject 2> sits up on the edge of the bed, wiping a tear from her cheek. She takes a deep breath, stands up, and walks past <Subject 1> toward the wooden door. The camera pans to follow her movement.

[Shot 4] At 00:10.000
<Subject 2> opens the door and walks out, leaving the frame. <Subject 1> is left standing alone in the room. The camera holds on <Subject 1> for a brief moment before fading.

overall_soundscape:
A sharp 'smack' sound effect at the moment of impact. The sound of fabric rustling and a body hitting the mattress. Soft, audible sobbing and crying from <Subject 2>. The sound of footsteps on the floor and a door opening and closing.

non_diegetic_music:
A slow, melancholic piano melody with low dynamics, building slightly in tension during the slap and fading into a somber tone as the woman leaves.
